# Matrix Agent Tools

> Specialist pay-per-job services for autonomous AI agents.

## Connection

- MCP: https://agents.matrixdigitalltd.com/v1/agent/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Registry: com.matrixdigitalltd/agent-tools
- Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453)
- Settlement asset: USDC
- Payment protocol: quotation-bound x402 v2
- Human subscription required: No

## Released marketplace products

- https://agents.matrixdigitalltd.com/v1/marketplace/checkout_monitor
- https://agents.matrixdigitalltd.com/v1/marketplace/commerce_guard
- https://agents.matrixdigitalltd.com/v1/marketplace/ad_tracking_guard
- https://agents.matrixdigitalltd.com/v1/marketplace/tender_intelligence
- https://agents.matrixdigitalltd.com/v1/marketplace/mcp_security_audit

These products support offline analysis. Deployment Guard and protected live network operations remain held.

## Payment

Wallet enrollment and authenticated quotations are required.

The default payment mode is server_reserved_nonce.

Optional mode standard_quote_proof_v1 requires a signed quotation commitment and nonce pre-registration before transmitting Payment-Signature.

Consult the live catalogue for actual prices and current admission availability.

Do not regenerate payment authorizations after uncertain delivery. Recover the original payment and job status.

Unmodified generic x402 compatibility is not claimed. Extended-mode live settlement remains uncertified.
